implementationNotes: Copy staging item-gallery directory to public/assets/item-gallery; map IDs are exact current catalog IDs.
Use object-fit:contain for full-screen item gallery and controls over transparent/glass surfaces. Never stretch images to card dimensions.
Tight firearm crops can remain thumbnails, but open the full 4K original wherever identified.
Nipper card can use photo-19 with object-position 28% 85% and modest CSS zoom; its gallery should show entire image.
For girardi and klose the additional official Personalized Weapon Variants image shows both pistols; do not label both as the selected model.
For enduro/kayak the safehouse photo is location context, not a second close-up.
The 61 new edition images include 2 Vintage Pack context images (edition-50/51) not assigned to unrelated entry galleries.
Only multiple images actually depicting the item or explicitly labeled context are mapped. Remaining 15 trailer/reference-only entries retain matched images, with no invented alternate angle.
Four album/single covers upgraded from440px to1425/3000px; other source art already1440/1920 or only960 available.
limitations: GTA Wiki requests and some GTABase individual pages blocked retrieval.
Direct artist social-post original files are not available in this environment. Four 960px square campaign images remain native960.
All current entries reviewed does not mean the full unreleased game catalog is known.
